tools.name: search_sneakers
tools.description: Searches the HYPEIBIZA catalogue for sneakers and streetwear by name, model or style code and returns up to 10 products with the lowest shop price.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Lists the shops that sell one product, with each shop's price, strike price, stock and the HYPEIBIZA link to the shop, optionally for one size.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Lists today's price drops at the shops HYPEIBIZA compares, optionally for one brand or model.

tools.name: convert_size
tools.description: Converts one shoe size of a brand between the EU, US and UK systems using the brand's own size chart.
